_comment: Expected Firebase project IDs per environment, read by scripts/verify_firebase_isolation.py.
Project IDs are identifiers, not secrets. NEVER put API keys, service-account JSON or private keys here.
Environment variables override these values: CARNET_FIREBASE_PROD_PROJECT_ID, CARNET_FIREBASE_DEV_PROJECT_ID, CARNET_FIREBASE_STAGE_PROJECT_ID.
A value that is empty or starts with REPLACE_WITH_ counts as NOT CONFIGURED: release verification then fails closed.
OWNER ACTION (F-20): create the separate dev and stage Firebase projects in the console, put their project IDs below,
replace android/app/src/{dev,stage}/google-services.json with the downloaded configs, then enable CARNET_FIREBASE_STRICT=1 in CI.
'prod' is pinned to the project ID already present in the committed prod configs; the owner must confirm it is the intended production project.
